name: Zhang Chunjiao
current_role: Chairman and General Manager, WG Tech (JiangXi) Group Co., Ltd. (沃格光电, SSE: 603773)
profile: Zhang Chunjiao (张春姣, b. Dec 1972) is co-founder of WG Tech, a Xinyu, Jiangxi maker of optoelectronic glass and glass circuit plates founded in 2009 and listed in Shanghai in 2018. Her wealth (per Hurun) is shared with co-founder Yi Weihua, the former controlling shareholder. She became GM in Nov 2022 and chairman in March 2026 after Yi stepped down.
interesting_fact: WG Tech says it is one of very few companies globally with full-process capability for GCP (glass circuit plate) technology, now used for glass-core substrates for high-compute chip packaging, optical-module glass substrates and Mini/MicroLED displays — directly relevant to AI/data-center hardware.
deep_cut_fact: Before running the company she worked her way through WG Tech as assistant to the general manager, vice president, head of the marketing center and special assistant to the chairman; the company credits her with nearly 20 years in optoelectronic display and supply-chain management.
notes: Name in filings is 张春姣 (input lists 张春娇). Board secretary is Gong Qingyu (龚庆宇); route via board office/IR email. Glass-substrate packaging angle fits the data-center theme.

name: Li Weicheng
current_role: Major shareholder (approx. 7-8%) of Raytron Technology (睿创微纳, SSE STAR: 688002); director until the Dec 2025 board re-election
profile: Li Weicheng (李维诚) is an early backer and one of the largest individual shareholders of Raytron Technology, a Yantai, Shandong maker of uncooled infrared thermal-imaging chips founded in 2009 by Ma Hong and listed on Shanghai's STAR Market in 2019 among its first batch. He held about 9.2% before selling part of his stake in 2025, and served as a director; he was not named to the board elected in Dec 2025.
interesting_fact: Raytron, in which he is a top shareholder, designs infrared, microwave and laser sensing chips used in thermal cameras, automotive driver-assist and AI devices; it was among the first 25 companies to list on the STAR Market in July 2019.
notes: Very low public profile; no personal biography found in filings searched. Filings name him and his wife Shi Yun (石筠) as acting-in-concert holders. Not an executive, so the company IR route is indirect. Hurun lists him for 2019-2026.
